backbone_shared.fusion: protected additive (learnable per-path alpha, init 1.0; no competitive gate)

B.desc: sliding window + FROZEN lightweight Phase recurrent state

C.desc: sliding window + FROZEN Phase + bounded binding slots

C-no-Phase.desc: sliding window + bounded binding slots (Phase removed)

decisive_comparisons.B_minus_A: Phase contribution on natural-language long-context evidence
decisive_comparisons.C_minus_B: binding-slot contribution when Phase is present
decisive_comparisons.C_minus_C-no-Phase: Phase contribution when binding slots are present

no_quadratic: verified via frozen shape_audit on every arm (raises on any two-sequence-axis tensor); local O(N*W), phase O(N*D) with O(D) state, slots O(N*M*D) with O(M*D) streaming state
